chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: The Hippety-Hop show versus Katy Crippen's vaudeville act
summary: Basie explains Hippety-Hop was a big burlesque-style show, while Katy Crippen's was a vaudeville act of a few players; he was with her act on the Hippety-Hop bill.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
